# Perfect Completeness of the Character-Pair Tester

**Claim.** If the linear and quadratic characters are generated by the same vector $\gamma$, the quadratic character pair tester accepts the resulting oracle with probability exactly $1$.

**Proof.** Choose the vector $\gamma$ witnessing that the pair has the required form, so the oracle is the linear character determined by $\gamma$ together with the matrix character determined by its rank-one self-matrix. The tester is a uniform mixture of three component testers. Its acceptance probability is therefore the average of the three component acceptance probabilities (`FABL.uniformMixtureFunctionTester_acceptanceProbability`). The linear BLR test accepts this oracle with probability $1$ (`FABL.quadraticPairLinearBLRTester_complete`); the matrix BLR test does as well (`FABL.quadraticPairMatrixBLRTester_complete`); and the rank-one test also accepts with probability $1$ (`FABL.quadraticPairRankOneTester_complete`). Thus the average of the three values is $1$.

**Key facts.** `FABL.uniformMixtureFunctionTester_acceptanceProbability`, `FABL.quadraticPairLinearBLRTester_complete`, `FABL.quadraticPairMatrixBLRTester_complete`, `FABL.quadraticPairRankOneTester_complete`.
